question: Does the whole company run one full cycle on its own — post, signal, lead, offer, close, delivery, record, a new good in the library, and that good becoming the next post — with Simon asked for exactly the steps that leave the company or commit it, and nothing else?
why: Simon's AI-first company spec (2026-10-28), build step 7: 'close the loop (one full autonomous cycle with Simon approving only the high-stakes)'. The loop: Kar thinks/gates → Grok reaches/acts → signals back → Kar reasons/routes/learns → Simon approves high-stakes → Kar converts/delivers/records → library grows → loop.

design.cycle: src/cycle.mjs cycle(world): (1) the post: the first library card drafted exactly as kar-voice drafts it (voice-core.mjs, vendored byte-identical), claim-gated, put to the conductor as 'post the receipt card on X', asked, sent as a dry run on approval; (2) the inbox: each line read by the reach reader (step 3) — refused lines recorded as refused at the door, read ones walked by the funnel (step 4); (3) each converted lead delivered by ops (step 5) with the deliverable for its offer; (4) the next post: every card the cycle added to the library is drafted and claim-gated and asked of Simon — and left waiting for him. Oversight (step 6) gates every outward step: it goes only if mayGo.
design.approvals: A rehearsal approver approves every ask except the next post, which is left waiting, as it would be for Simon's real word.

claims.claim: Simon is asked for exactly the six expected steps, in that order — no more, no fewer.

Everything else runs without him: every other step of the cycle (reading, refusing, qualifying, drafting, building, proving, recording, growing the library) is in the journal with no ask attached, and c2, c3 and c4 never produce an ask.
claims.pass: 0 asks outside the six; 0 asks for c2, c3, c4

claims.claim: Nothing outward without approval: every sent and handed-over item follows an approval of its exact text, and oversight's mayGo was true for it at that moment.
A rehearsal approval can never post for real: with live mode on, kar-voice's approval rule (vendored) refuses every one of the cycle's rehearsal approvals.
The loop closes: the good the cycle delivered (pilot-180k) is in the library, passes the claim gate at its pin, and is the next post — drafted, asked, and waiting for Simon.

claims.claim: The cycle's journal verifies end to end, and its dashboard equals a plain count of its entries.

scope: A rehearsal cycle on fixture inbox lines and fictional handles, with real pinned receipts as the goods; every outward step is a dry run and every approval a rehearsal record. Simon's real cycle starts when his connector, his Grok Bot routine and his own approvals exist.
